messages.author: Manuel Puerta da Costa
messages.message: 🔗 Barebone - AI Investment Agents on Instagram: "$1,000 into SanDisk a year ago is $31,000 today. You missed that one. Jensen Huang says robots are the next AI trade, but the real money is not in the robots themselves. It is in actuators, the muscles and joints that make them move. These are the kind of investing insights every trader and investor needs before trading the next supply chain bottleneck. Here is the full map. Every joint in a humanoid needs an actuator, dozens per robot, together nearly half the cost. We mapped the entire supply chain looking for where the fewest companies control it. Bottleneck plus extreme demand is exactly how SanDisk went 31x. The chain runs 5 layers deep. It starts with rare earth magnets. No magnet, no motor, no movement. MP Materials ($MP) is backed by the Pentagon and runs America's only rare earth mine at scale. Then magnets go into motors, which turn electricity into motion.
